scope: Local CI producer/verifier symmetry, required snapshots, effective source integrity, exact neutral/retained projection, importer pre-I/O and remote preflight controls only

findings.title: Public compiler build-info changes the sealed variant source hash
findings.observed: Successful exact public build adds five tsconfig.public.tsbuildinfo leaves which sourceFiles does not exclude. No removed/changed effective inputs; five added inputs alone change the derived hash.
findings.impact: runScope sets variantSourceMatch=false and status=FAIL for a clean successful harness-neutral/consumer-contract public build. This verdict is inferred from the exact final predicate; the full CI runner was not executed.
findings.requiredCorrection: Bind the finite outputs of the actual public compiler configuration, including its exact build-info leaves, without excluding arbitrary dist/.gauntlet/certification inputs.

findings.title: PostgreSQL version validation is asymmetric before snapshots
findings.observed: snapshotSchema accepts both string "160000" and fractional 160000.5. Exact pure-constant producer predicates accept both; verifySnapshots rejects both as postgres_version_binding.
findings.impact: Producer admission can mark a malformed version PASS and copy the snapshot before downstream verifier rejection. This is not a demonstrated remote trust bypass; real PostgreSQL was not called.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require Number.isSafeInteger(version) with the same schema and binding validation on producer, importer and verifier before successful artifact emission.

findings.title: Producer validates Pg/chaos membership using the report itself
findings.observed: Collected command-selected memberships: Pg 35 files/288 cases; chaos 3 files/20 cases. Removing one case from each inert native report still passes the exact testReport(report, report-derived-files) producer admission. The verifier, using frozen commands + collected manifest membership, rejects both omissions.
findings.impact: Producer can emit success snapshots missing command-required cases; asymmetric evidence is rejected only at aggregation. The downstream required member checks are correct, and neither native Pg nor chaos tests were executed.
findings.requiredCorrection: Pass the independently command-selected collected inventory into producer validation, checking complete case IDs, multiplicity, file membership and statuses before snapshotOutputs.

findings.title: Eval validator admits outcomes impossible for native integer counts
findings.observed: Starting from the hash-bound native 56-scenario report, snapshotSchema accepts (a) zero failed scenarios/taskSuccessRate=1 but adversarialPassRate=0.95, and (b) schemaFailureRate=hallucinationRate=0.001. Native computeMetrics yields adversarialPassRate=1 when every scenario succeeds, including an empty adversarial group; 56*0.001=0.056 is not a possible integer hallucinations count.
findings.impact: Contradictory eval PASS can pass both producer and snapshot validation; ranges and thresholds alone do not ensure actual numerator/denominator/group semantics. No evaluator or agent was instantiated by these probes.
findings.requiredCorrection: Bind integral scenario numerators/denominators and adversarial group membership to native collected outcomes or an exact native producer projection; reject impossible rates while preserving legitimate native tolerable failures.
